title: Beautiful until I noticed cracks
text:
Beautiful until I noticed cracks. ***after more inspections I notices a huge foot long Crack in the tables wood. So disappointing. Now I have to take it back apart and return it.***
Absolutely stunning! Well packaged and matches my 2 bar stools perfectly. I'm so happy with this purchase. Super easy for me to assemble by myself also, no need for hubby for this one.
